verdict.rationale: Trilegal documents strong M&A (Corporate practice, Tier 1 ranking) and private-equity exit routes that explicitly include IPOs, secondary sales, and trade sales, plus VC/fund expertise, showing exit-related experience for venture-backed companies. However, there is no dedicated capital-markets/IPO practice page — public-offering work is only mentioned as one bullet under the PE exits page rather than documented with its own dedicated expertise page and deal examples. Missing for 10: a standalone capital markets/IPO practice page, specific venture-backed IPO case studies, and cross-border public-offering credentials.
